text: Merged: #6751 (Currency functions), #6754 (Currency overflow 1988). Open: #6755 (aggregates keep operand type, #6040/#6041). Next PR on fix/currency-val-overflow: VAL('$...') outside the Currency range is error 1988 (probed; RQ-CF-PRG-031 assumed 39 by analogy), rounds half-away to 4 decimals before the range check, refuses the stored minimum and ignores an exponent (also fixes #5996; $1E3 = $1.0000). Then #6168 (TRANSFORM '$999' picture, probed) and #6742 (exact 128-bit Currency * and /); #6035 (int64 arithmetic after DECLARE) has no VFP9 oracle since VFP9 has no 64-bit integer, so I will treat it as design-first.
